messages.author: e0ca5a0f7a37b5e8
messages.subject: Interactions in INLA
parts:
Dear R-INLA project

How do I include an interaction in an inla model? For example, I want to interact two categorical variables (each one has more than 3 levels).

Using the glm() function I would use

factor(catvar1)+factor(catvar2) +factor(catvar1):factor(catvar2)

or

factor(catvar1)*factor(catvar2)

Many thanks
